name: Scarlet 11 Lipstick
description: A satin lipstick in a heavy square-section case shown open: the base in high-gloss scarlet lacquer with a mirror-polished chrome collar band at its top, the satin scarlet bullet twisted fully up with a sharp angled tip, and the matching square scarlet lacquer cap standing upright just to the right of the base; ILSE VARDEN printed in white spaced capitals running vertically up the front face of the base and a small white 11 at the foot of the same face, nothing printed on the cap.
dimensions: about 7.5 cm tall with its cap and 2.2 cm square
subcategory: satin lipstick in a square lacquered case
materials: zinc-alloy case in high-gloss scarlet lacquer, mirror-polished chrome collar band, satin-finish scarlet bullet
negativeConstraints: Never invent any text, logo, wordmark or mark beyond the ones this record names, never misspell or rearrange those, and never add a second label. No round case, no gold case, no printing on the cap, no second shade.
preservationNotes: Keep the print exactly: ILSE VARDEN in white spaced capitals running vertically up the front face of the base, and a small white 11 at its foot; nothing on the cap. Keep the square high-gloss scarlet lacquer case, the chrome collar band and the satin scarlet bullet with its sharp angled tip in every shot.
